decision_context: Archive convictions were retained, without re-judging them. Each listed extracted member was examined independently from its source and decoded executable bytes.

Empire and DAVTest packaging, upstream tool names, authorship and licensing were considered as security-assessment provenance. The selected members implement deployable compromise, credential-harvesting or command-control payloads; those implemented paths tip the individual artifact judgements.

Several modules require operator parameters or deployment substitution. The supplied material contains no execution history, assessed target scope, assessment authorization or verified package-signing record. The verdicts do not assert observed execution or a proven unauthorized deployment.

Bundled library code was distinguished from its caller: System.Data.SQLite and the ETW/NAudio dependencies are legitimate libraries, while the listed wrappers use them for password or input/audio collection.

rule_corrections.unsupported_claim: Path/store references alone do not establish browser discovery or storage access. LevelDB is also used outside browsers.
rule_corrections.retained: Identical OR legs, file/platform scope, confidence and notable criticality; removed the unsupported T1217 mapping. Exact consumers and discovery-ancestor consumers retain the same evidence explicitly.

rule_corrections.unsupported_claim: A matcher requiring user.config describes a configuration file, whose specific resource home precedes general app data.
rule_corrections.retained: Matcher, scope, confidence and notable criticality unchanged; the retained nordvpn-path atom already covers the old app-data parent population. No exact consumer of nordvpn-config existed.

consumer_audit: Exact storage selector consumers: wallet-messaging-session-stealer and windows-browser-clipboard-stealer; both references updated without changing conjunction/cardinality.
Discovery ancestor consumers: credential-export-with-recon-or-ranking plus both documented-vendor endpoint exceptions; explicitly retain the moved observation to preserve their former populations.

App-data ancestor consumers: Go resource POST, DNS/resource proximity and Node/resource proximity. None counts the group under a needs threshold; reference evidence remains neutral. The NordVPN path atom preserves membership for the relocated configuration rule.
Configuration-app ancestor consumer: javascript-targeted-sensitive-path-upload. The added NordVPN configuration-file observation fits its existing required configuration/read/upload roles.

tests.focused_result: 3 cases passed, including the pre-existing passive Discord/Local Storage fixture outside this batch; normal references remain non-hostile.
tests.all_samples: atomscan and cleave facts collected for all 57 members and 3 archives; atomscan repeated after edits. A separate original-rule snapshot was scanned uncached for controlled comparisons.
tests.comparison: Normalized only the two documented ID relocations; compared findings in the supplied artifacts, decoded layers and archive members. No lost or added local findings and no hostile/suspicious losses in the controlled before/after comparison.
tests.cache_observation: Initial cached macOS reports differed in x64/ARM64 XOR evidence and low-value finding presentation. Uncached scans against original and edited rules produced identical facts/findings and the same classifier probability. This was analyzer/cache variation, not an attack-coverage reduction.
tests.linked_content: Some scanner reports included previously followed documentation/remote assets despite --follow none. Their rows and descendants were excluded from sample-byte comparison and were not used to establish the member verdicts.
tests.outside_attack_controls: Original-rule and edited-rule scans retain every finding on validated-installer-clipboard.sh and gui-clipboard-copy-paste.py.
